summary: Makes onSave async so it writes a JSON snapshot of the in-memory store to data/notes.json after each save.

findings.title: Async onSave returns a Promise to a synchronous caller
findings.problem: onSave now returns a Promise, but dispatch in src/router.js:7 returns it unchanged. The server in src/main.js:9 passes that Promise straight to res.end, which accepts only a string or Buffer.
findings.consequence: Every POST /save request makes res.end throw a TypeError inside the request listener, which crashes the server process. The Promise is also never awaited, so a writeFile failure becomes an unhandled rejection.
findings.fix: Await the result along the whole call path. Make dispatch async and have the server await it, catch errors and send an error response.

findings.title: Snapshot write has no covering test
findings.problem: onSave now writes the store to disk and returns a Promise. The repository has no test that covers this behaviour.
findings.consequence: A test would have caught the broken return type at the HTTP layer. Without one, future regressions in persistence will also go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add a test that calls dispatch for a save action and checks the response text. The test should also check the snapshot file contents.
